title: Annotatio VI §.I: Indigni secundum quid — weak lapse toward Supper without due repentance
pass_a_gloss: OR UNWORTHY IN A QUALIFIED SENSE and in respect only of approaching the Holy Supper — who otherwise habitually pious, yet having fallen into sin against conscience from some weakness of the flesh, approach the Lord’s holy supper without first examining themselves enough, i.e. with sufficient repentance, their sins deleted in Christ’s Blood applied to themselves by living faith.
pass_b_english: Second: unworthy in a qualified sense, only as to approaching the Supper.

Otherwise habitually pious, they have fallen against conscience by fleshly weakness and come to the Lord’s table without enough self-examination — without sufficient repentance and sins wiped in Christ’s blood by living faith.
source_text: VEL INDIGNI SECUNDUM QUID & respectu solius S. Cœnæ adeundæ, qui alioquin habitualiter pii, in peccatum, tamen contra conscientiam, ex imbecillitate quadam carnis, lapsi, S. Domini cœnam accedunt, non ante exploratis satis se ipsis, i. e. pœnitentia sufficienti, peccatis suis deletis, in Sanguine Christi, fide viva sibi applicato.
